name: reverse-grip-bench-press.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the reverse grip bench press by setting the height of the bench rack (if it's adjustable) and adding the weight plates you want to use.
2. Lay down on your back with your feet firmly planted on the floor. Grasp the bar with an underhand grip (palms facing your head) with your hands wider than shoulder width.
3. Take the bar off the rack. Slowly lower the bar straight down to the middle of your chest, but don't let the bar touch your chest.
4. Pause, then slowly raise the bar back up. Do not lock your elbows out or rest at the top and go straight back into your next rep.
5. Repeat this process for your desired reps.
